metadata.title: RC-positivity of complex surfaces
metadata.abstract: Given a compact complex surface with a nonflat Ricci-flat Kähler metric, we show that its holomorphic tangent bundle admits an RC-positive Hermitian metric. The proof relies on a characterization of RC-positivity through the anti-self-dual part of the Weyl operator, the Weitzenböck formula on the four dimensional Einstein manifold, and a conformal perturbation on the Ricci-flat metric. As a consequence, we prove that RC-positivity is not preserved after taking tensor, exterior, or symmetric power. Moreover, we show that RC-positivity is a strictly weaker notion than uniform RC-positivity, and that RC-positivity of holomorphic tangent bundle does not necessarily imply rational connectedness of the base manifold.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 证明非平坦 Ricci-flat Kähler 紧复曲面的切丛可赋 RC 正 Hermitian 度量，并推出 RC 正性不由张量、外幂、对称幂保持，也不迫使底流形有理连通。
techniques: 反自对偶 Weyl 算子
analysis.breakthrough: 严格区分 RC 正性、统一 RC 正性及有理连通性。
analysis.limitations: RC 正的是所构造丛度量，而非原 Ricci-flat 度量的 Ricci 正性。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 厘清复曲率正性条件之间易混淆的蕴含关系。
